titleEn: Stuffed Eggplants with Spiced Ground Meat
description: Silky baked eggplants stuffed with a savory filling of spiced ground beef, sweet onions, garlic, and fresh parsley.

ingredients.name: Ground Beef (85/15)
ingredients.substitute: 85/15 ground beef mixed with 10% ground lamb for a richer flavor

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.substitute: 1 tsp jarred minced garlic per clove

ingredients.name: Italian Frying Peppers
ingredients.substitute: Anaheim peppers or mild green bell pepper

steps.instruction: Peel alternating lengthwise strips from the eggplants, leaving a striped pattern. Brush with some oil and roast at 400°F (200°C) until softened.
Meanwhile, sauté the chopped onion in oil until translucent, then add garlic and ground beef. Cook, breaking up the meat, until browned.
Stir in tomato paste, chopped tomatoes, peppers, parsley, cumin, salt, and pepper. Simmer until the filling thickens slightly.
Make a lengthwise slit in each eggplant and gently open it. Fill with the meat mixture and arrange in a baking dish.
Add a splash of water to the dish and bake at 375°F (190°C) until the eggplants are very tender and the filling is bubbling.

titleEn: Sultan's Delight: Lamb over Smoky Eggplant Purée
description: Tender lamb stew served over a velvety roasted eggplant purée enriched with milk and cheese.

ingredients.name: Boneless Lamb Shoulder
ingredients.substitute: Beef chuck cut into small cubes

ingredients.name: All-Purpose Flour
ingredients.substitute: 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with cold milk

ingredients.name: Whole Milk
ingredients.substitute: Half-and-half diluted with a little water

ingredients.name: Low-Moisture Mozzarella
ingredients.substitute: Young Gouda or mild Kashar if available

steps.instruction: Roast the eggplants over a gas flame or under the broiler, turning until the skins are charred and the flesh is soft. Cover briefly, then peel and chop the flesh.
Brown the lamb cubes in olive oil in a heavy pot. Add chopped onion and cook until softened.
Stir in tomato paste, salt, pepper, and enough hot water to nearly cover. Cover and simmer gently until lamb is tender.
Melt butter in a saucepan, stir in flour, and cook briefly. Gradually whisk in milk until thick and smooth.
Fold the chopped eggplant and grated cheese into the sauce. Stir over low heat until creamy, then spoon onto plates and top with lamb.

titleEn: Iskender Kebab with Tomato Butter Sauce
description: Thinly sliced seasoned beef over toasted pita, topped with tomato sauce, melted butter, and yogurt.

ingredients.name: Beef Sirloin or Ribeye
ingredients.substitute: Thinly sliced steak or good-quality shaved beef

ingredients.name: Greek Pita Bread
ingredients.substitute: Thick Turkish pide or sturdy flatbread, cubed and toasted

steps.instruction: Freeze the beef for 20–30 minutes to firm it, then slice as thinly as possible across the grain.
Toast pita cubes in a dry skillet or oven until lightly crisp; arrange on serving plates.
Sear beef in batches in a very hot skillet with olive oil, seasoning with salt, pepper, and paprika.
Melt 1 tbsp butter and cook tomato paste with a splash of water until it forms a smooth sauce.
Warm the remaining butter until foaming. Spoon tomato sauce over pita, add beef, then drizzle with butter and serve with yogurt.

titleEn: Ali Nazik Kebab with Lamb and Eggplant Yogurt
description: Smoky eggplant blended with garlicky yogurt and topped with tender spiced lamb or beef.

ingredients.name: Ground or Small-Cubed Lamb
ingredients.substitute: 85/15 ground beef or beef chuck cubes

steps.instruction: Char eggplants over a flame or roast under a broiler, turning until collapsed and smoky. Cover, cool slightly, peel, and chop.
Mix eggplant with yogurt, crushed garlic, and salt; spread onto a warm serving platter.
Cook lamb in a skillet until browned and cooked through. Add butter, tomato paste, cumin, paprika, pepper, and a splash of water.
Simmer briefly until the meat is coated in a glossy sauce, then spoon over the eggplant yogurt and serve.

description: Homestyle Turkish beef meatballs seasoned with onion, parsley, cumin, and breadcrumbs.

ingredients.name: Ground Beef (85/15)
ingredients.substitute: Half ground beef and half ground lamb for a traditional variation

ingredients.name: Egg
ingredients.substitute: 2 tbsp plain yogurt as a binder

steps.instruction: Grate the onion and squeeze out excess liquid. Combine with beef, breadcrumbs, egg, parsley, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Knead the mixture briefly, shape into small oval patties, and refrigerate to help them hold their shape.
Pan-fry in a thin layer of oil over medium heat, turning until browned and the center reaches 160°F (71°C).

description: Juicy chicken cubes marinated with yogurt, lemon, paprika, and garlic, then grilled on skewers.

ingredients.name: Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs
ingredients.substitute: Chicken breast, taking care not to overcook

steps.instruction: Cut chicken into 1-inch cubes. Mix yogurt, lemon juice, oil, garlic, paprika, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Toss chicken in the marinade, cover, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread chicken onto skewers. Grill over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until the thickest pieces reach 165°F (74°C).

description: Long, fiery kebabs made from seasoned ground lamb and red pepper, traditionally grilled over charcoal.

ingredients.name: Ground Lamb
ingredients.substitute: Ground beef with 15–20% fat, or a beef-lamb blend

ingredients.name: Aleppo Pepper or Turkish Red Pepper Flakes

steps.instruction: Combine lamb, finely minced pepper, chili flakes, garlic, and salt. Knead until the mixture becomes tacky.
Divide into four portions and press each around a wide metal skewer. Chill briefly if the mixture feels soft.
Grill over high heat, turning carefully, until browned and cooked through to 160°F (71°C). Serve with flatbread.

titleEn: Turkish Lamb Stew in a Clay-Pot Style
description: Slow-braised lamb with vegetables, tomato, and peppers, inspired by traditional Turkish clay-pot stew.

ingredients.name: Green Bell Peppers
ingredients.substitute: Anaheim peppers or Italian frying peppers

ingredients.name: Salt, Pepper, Thyme
ingredients.substitute: Dried oregano in place of thyme

steps.instruction: Heat oven to 325°F (165°C). Cut lamb and vegetables into bite-size pieces.
Toss lamb, potatoes, onion, tomatoes, peppers, garlic, tomato paste, oil, and seasonings in a heavy oven-safe pot.
Add about 1 cup hot water, cover tightly, and braise until the lamb is fork-tender. Check once during cooking and add water if needed.
Uncover for the final 10 minutes if you prefer a thicker sauce. Rest briefly before serving.

description: Tender lamb simmered with peas, carrots, potatoes, and a light tomato broth.

ingredients.name: Boneless Lamb or Beef Stew Meat

steps.instruction: Brown the meat in olive oil in a heavy pot. Add chopped onion and cook until softened.
Stir in tomato paste and enough hot water to mostly cover the meat. Cover and simmer until beginning to tenderize.
Add diced potatoes and carrots; continue simmering until the vegetables and meat are tender.
Stir in peas and cook until heated through. Adjust seasoning and serve hot.

titleEn: White Beans with Turkish Cured Beef
description: A comforting Turkish white bean stew enriched with pastırma, a spiced cured beef; smoked beef makes a practical US substitute.

ingredients.name: Pastırma
ingredients.substitute: Thinly sliced bresaola or pastrami; use smoked beef if preferred

ingredients.name: Salt, Black Pepper, Paprika
ingredients.substitute: Adjust salt because cured beef is salty

steps.instruction: Sauté chopped onion in butter or olive oil until soft. Add tomato paste and cook briefly.
Add sliced pastırma or its substitute and cook for 2 minutes to release its flavor.
Add drained beans and broth. Simmer gently until the sauce thickens and flavors combine.
Season carefully, remembering that cured beef is salty, and serve hot.

titleEn: Izmir-Style Meatballs with Potatoes in Tomato Sauce
description: Seasoned Turkish meatballs baked with potato wedges and peppers in a savory tomato sauce.

ingredients.name: Ground Beef (85/15)
ingredients.substitute: Ground beef mixed with a little ground lamb

steps.instruction: Heat oven to 400°F (200°C). Combine beef, grated onion, breadcrumbs, egg, cumin, salt, and pepper; shape into oval meatballs.
Cut potatoes into wedges. Lightly brown the potatoes and meatballs in a skillet if desired, working in batches.
Arrange potatoes, meatballs, and pepper pieces in a baking dish. Whisk tomato paste with 1 1/2 cups hot water and pour over.
Bake until potatoes are tender, sauce is bubbling, and meatballs reach 160°F (71°C) internally.

description: Slow-simmered cubes of beef with onions and tomato, served with a rich, comforting gravy.

ingredients.name: Salt, Pepper, Bay Leaf
ingredients.substitute: Dried thyme can replace bay leaf

steps.instruction: Pat beef dry and brown in batches in a heavy pot with hot oil or butter.
Add chopped onion and garlic; cook until fragrant. Stir in tomato paste.
Add broth, carrot, bay leaf, salt, and pepper. Cover and simmer gently until beef is fork-tender.
Remove bay leaf, adjust seasoning, and serve with rice or mashed potatoes.

description: Tender oval meat patties made with beef, cooked rice, and herbs, coated in egg and lightly fried.

ingredients.name: Eggs
ingredients.substitute: No direct substitute recommended for the coating

steps.instruction: Sauté half the ground beef with chopped onion until cooked through; cool completely.
Mix the cooled beef with the remaining raw beef, cooked rice, parsley, one egg, and seasonings. Shape into oval patties and chill briefly.
Set out flour and beat the remaining egg in a shallow bowl. Coat each patty lightly in flour, then dip in egg.
Shallow-fry in batches over medium heat until golden and the centers reach 160°F (71°C). Drain on paper towels.

description: Quick skillet chicken with tomatoes, peppers, onions, and warm Mediterranean spices.

ingredients.name: Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs or Breast
ingredients.substitute: Chicken tenders, cut into bite-size pieces

steps.instruction: Cut chicken into bite-size pieces and chop the onion, pepper, tomatoes, and garlic.
Heat oil in a large skillet. Sear chicken in batches until lightly browned.
Add onion and pepper; cook until beginning to soften. Stir in garlic and tomato paste.
Add tomatoes and spices. Simmer until the chicken reaches 165°F (74°C) and the sauce thickens.

titleEn: Crispy Shoestring Potato Kebab with Beef
description: Aegean-style kebab layered with garlicky yogurt, thin crispy potatoes, and sautéed beef in tomato butter sauce.

ingredients.name: Beef Sirloin
ingredients.substitute: Shaved steak or thinly sliced flank steak

steps.instruction: Cut potatoes into very thin matchsticks, rinse, and dry thoroughly with a clean towel.
Fry potatoes in batches in 350°F (175°C) oil until crisp and golden. Drain and lightly salt.
Mix yogurt with crushed garlic and a pinch of salt; spread on a serving platter.
Sear thinly sliced beef in a hot skillet until browned and cooked through; season with salt and pepper.
Cook tomato paste with butter and a splash of water to make a quick sauce. Layer crispy potatoes and beef over yogurt, then spoon the sauce on top.

titleEn: Traditional Kayseri Dumplings with Garlic Yogurt
description: Authentic miniature Anatolian hand-pinched dumplings packed with seasoned minced beef and onion. Served drowning in silky cold garlic yogurt and drizzled with foaming paprika-mint butter and tangy sumac.

ingredients.name: All-Purpose Flour
ingredients.substitute: Unbleached pastry flour or Italian tipo 00

ingredients.name: Ground Beef (lean)
ingredients.substitute: Lean ground lamb or mixed beef-lamb

ingredients.name: Sweet Paprika & Dried Mint
ingredients.substitute: Turkish pul biber (Aleppo pepper) and dried spearmint

ingredients.name: Salt and Freshly Cracked Black Pepper

steps.instruction: In a large bowl, knead flour, egg, warm water, and 1 tsp salt into a firm, elastic dough. Cover and rest.
Mix ground beef with finely grated squeezed onion, black pepper, and salt until tacky and cohesive.
Roll dough out thinly (approx. 1 mm) on a floured surface. Cut into 1-inch (2.5 cm) squares. Place a lentil-sized bead of meat in each center and pinch four corners together.
Boil dumplings in a large pot of salted rolling boiling water until they float and soften.
Melt butter with paprika, red pepper flakes, and dried mint until foaming and fragrant.
Drain mantı, place into shallow bowls, top generously with garlic yogurt, and drizzle with hot sizzling spiced butter.

description: Exquisite torpedo-shaped crispy bulgur shells filled with a spiced minced beef, toasted walnut, and caramelized onion stuffing. A hallmark of Southeastern Anatolian hospitality, fried to deep golden perfection.

ingredients.name: Ground Beef for Filling (20% fat)
ingredients.substitute: Finely minced beef chuck or lamb

ingredients.name: Turkish Red Pepper Paste (Biber Salçası)
ingredients.substitute: Double-concentrated tomato paste mixed with sweet paprika

steps.instruction: Cook ground beef with diced onions until browned and dry. Stir in pepper paste, spices, and chopped walnuts. Chill thoroughly until solidified.
Soak bulgur and semolina in 1.5 cups warm water for 15 minutes, then knead vigorously with flour and 1 egg until a smooth, crack-free paste forms.
Shape walnut-sized balls of dough. Hollow the center using a wet index finger into a thin egg-like cylinder shell. Stuff with cold filling and seal into pointed torpedoes.
Deep fry in hot oil (365°F / 185°C) in batches until golden brown and crisp, then drain on paper towels.

description: Signature spice-infused minced lamb pressed flat into a round baking tray, accented with garlic, red capia peppers, and fresh herbs, then baked until caramelized in its natural rich meat juices.

ingredients.name: Minced Lamb and Beef Blend (Zırh kıyması style)
ingredients.substitute: 80/20 ground beef mixed with 20% ground lamb

ingredients.name: Turkish Pepper Paste (Biber Salçası)
ingredients.substitute: Tomato paste with pinch of smoked paprika

ingredients.name: Ground Cumin & Maras Chili Flakes
ingredients.substitute: Ground cumin and crushed red pepper flakes

steps.instruction: Knead minced meat with finely chopped capia peppers, garlic, salt, cumin, chili flakes, and half the pepper paste for 5 minutes until fully bound.
Spread and press the meat evenly into the bottom of an oiled 11-inch round baking tray about 1.5 cm thick. Slice into triangular wedges with a wet knife.
Top with tomato wedges and green chili strips. Whisk remaining pepper paste with 1/2 cup warm water and pour over the meat.
Bake in a preheated oven at 400°F (200°C) until sizzling, browned, and bubbling with caramelized juices.

description: Fall-off-the-bone succulent lamb shanks seared golden and slow-braised with pearl onions, whole garlic heads, carrots, and fragrant fresh thyme in a rich tomato demi-glace.

ingredients.name: Lamb Shanks (trimmed)
ingredients.substitute: Veal shanks or bone-in beef short ribs

steps.instruction: Season lamb shanks generously with salt and black pepper. Sear in olive oil over high heat in a Dutch oven until deeply browned on all sides.
Remove meat, sauté shallots and carrots for 3 minutes, then stir in tomato-pepper paste and cook for 1 minute.
Return lamb shanks, pour in broth, add herbs and garlic halves. Cover tightly with parchment and foil or a heavy lid.
Bake at 325°F (165°C) until meat is extraordinarily tender and pulling away cleanly from the bone.

titleEn: Beyti Kebab Wrapped in Lavash Bread
description: Garlic-kissed grilled minced lamb skewers wrapped snugly in crisp lavash flatbread, sliced into bite-sized medallions, and smothered in warm tomato sauce, sizzling foaming butter, and creamy yogurt.

ingredients.name: Fresh Thin Lavash Flatbreads
ingredients.substitute: Large 12-inch flour tortillas or Lebanese lavash

steps.instruction: Knead ground meat with garlic, finely diced onion, salt, pepper, and chopped parsley until smooth. Form into long, flat sausage-like skewers.
Grill or sear skewers in a ridged skillet until cooked through and lightly charred.
Brush lavash with melted butter, wrap tightly around each kebab skewer, and cut diagonally into 1.5-inch rolls. Arrange cut-side up on a baking sheet and crisp in a 390°F (200°C) oven.
Simmer tomato paste with crushed tomatoes and butter into a silky sauce. Plate beyti rolls in a circle around a mound of yogurt, spoon sauce over rolls, and top with foaming browned butter.

description: Ancestral horizontal-spit roasted sliced lamb marinated for days in onion juice, black pepper, and yogurt. Skewered on handheld cağ skewers and seared over wood embers for unbeatable smoky depth.

ingredients.name: Boneless Lamb Leg or Shoulder (sliced thin)
ingredients.substitute: Ribeye beef steaks sliced very thin

steps.instruction: Marinate thin lamb slices in onion juice, yogurt, freshly cracked black pepper, and salt in a sealed container in the refrigerator for at least 12 hours.
Thread marinated lamb ribbons tightly onto flat metal skewers accordion-style.
Sear over high charcoal embers or a screaming-hot cast iron grill pan, flipping frequently until edges are crisp and charred while interior stays tender.
Serve immediately off the skewer onto hot lavash flatbread alongside roasted tomatoes and sumac onions.

description: Famous cylindrical, extraordinarily springy Turkish meatballs crafted without bread or dominant spices, seasoned purely with onion and baking soda, then rested for 24 hours to develop their iconic juicy bite.

ingredients.name: Ground Beef Chuck & Lamb (80/20 mix, finely ground twice)

steps.instruction: Knead finely ground meat with salt for 10 minutes. Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours.
Dissolve baking soda in lemon juice. Add to meat along with drained grated onion and knead for another 10 minutes until elastic and bouncy.
Shape into 3-inch long fingers (about 1.5 cm diameter). Rest in the fridge for 2 hours.
Grill on high heat on a cast iron grates, turning continuously so all sides brown evenly without drying out.

description: Tender spiced Turkish meatballs wrapped like exquisite parcels in crosswise strips of fried eggplant, secured with a toothpick, crowned with tomato and pepper, and baked in a rich tomato sauce.

steps.instruction: Slice eggplants lengthwise into 1/4-inch planks. Salt for 15 minutes, pat dry, and fry lightly in oil until pliable.
Knead ground beef with breadcrumbs, onion, garlic, egg, cumin, salt, and pepper. Form into plump golf-ball-sized patties and sear briefly on both sides.
Lay two eggplant slices in a plus (+) cross. Place a meatball in the center, fold slices over, top with a tomato slice and green chili, and secure with a toothpick.
Arrange in a baking dish, pour diluted tomato paste sauce around the parcels, and bake at 380°F (190°C) until bubbling and golden.

description: Anatolian clay-oven classic featuring whole lamb shoulder slow-roasted until meltingly tender, caramelized on the outside and effortlessly pulling apart with two forks. Served over aromatic buttery Turkish rice pilaf.

steps.instruction: Make small slits all over the lamb shoulder and insert peeled garlic cloves. Rub the meat thoroughly with olive oil, crushed thyme, salt, and pepper.
Place the lamb into a heavy Dutch oven, splash in 1/2 cup water, and cover tightly with damp parchment paper then double-layer aluminum foil and the lid.
Slow-roast at 300°F (150°C) undisturbed until tender.
Uncover and roast at 425°F (220°C) for a final burst to crisp and caramelize the outer fat cap.

description: Hearty Ottoman meatball bowls molded like savory nests, filled with velvet-smooth kaşar cheese mashed potatoes, and baked in savory tomato gravy until bubbly and lightly gratinated.

steps.instruction: Knead meat with grated onion, egg, breadcrumbs, cumin, salt, and pepper. Shape into 6 large balls, then press centers to create deep edible nest bowls.
Mash warm boiled potatoes with butter, warm milk, half the cheese, and a pinch of nutmeg until velvety.
Pipe or spoon the mashed potatoes generously into each meatball nest. Top with remaining grated cheese.
Pour tomato sauce around the nests in the baking tray and bake at 390°F (200°C) until meatballs are cooked through and cheese is bubbling golden.

description: Antakya butcher-shop tradition where seasoned knife-minced lamb and beef is pressed wafer-thin onto greaseproof parchment paper, then wood-fired to lock in natural moisture and peppery aromatics.

steps.instruction: Knead minced meat with crushed garlic, pepper paste, black pepper, and salt until tacky and cohesive.
Cut circles of baking parchment paper. Press meat onto paper into a thin 0.5-inch disc right to the edges.
Top with tomato wedges and sliced long peppers. Place parchment directly on a scorching hot baking sheet or pizza stone at 450°F (230°C).
Serve sizzling hot straight on its parchment paper with fresh tırnak pide bread.

description: Paper-thin ribbons of tender fresh calf's liver dredged in seasoned flour and flash-fried in boiling oil for mere seconds. Served with blistered sun-dried fiery Karaağaç red peppers and sumac onion salad.

ingredients.name: Fresh Calf's Liver (veins stripped, sliced paper-thin)
ingredients.substitute: Very fresh beef liver sliced leaf-thin

ingredients.name: Dried Turkish Whole Red Peppers (Karaağaç biberi)
ingredients.substitute: Dried mild New Mexico chili pods

steps.instruction: Wash sliced liver briefly and drain thoroughly in a colander until dry. Do not let it sit in water.
Heat oil in a wide frying pan until shimmering hot (375°F / 190°C). Flash-fry dried red peppers for 25 seconds until crisp, then set aside.
Toss liver strips in flour, shaking off all excess through a sieve. Fry in boiling oil in small batches for only 60 to 90 seconds until edges curl and crisp.
Drain immediately, season with salt, and serve piping hot with crispy dried chilies and sumac onions.

description: Elegant rolled Turkish baked meatloaf stuffed with a mosaic center of whole hard-boiled eggs, sweet carrots, and tender green peas, glazed in rich tomato-butter gravy and sliced into stunning rounds.

steps.instruction: Knead ground beef with grated onion, breadcrumbs, raw egg, cumin, black pepper, and salt for 10 minutes until dense and pliable.
Spread meat on baking paper into a rectangle (approx. 2 cm thick). Align hard-boiled eggs, carrots, and peas down the center.
Roll the meat tightly over the filling into a seamless log, sealing edges well. Brush with oil and bake at 380°F (190°C).
Brush with tomato paste glaze and bake an additional 10 minutes. Rest 10 minutes before slicing into rounds.

titleEn: Ankara Baked Lamb and Orzo Casserole
description: Tender lamb chunks braised with onions, tomatoes, and peppers, baked together with toasted orzo (şehriye) until the pasta absorbs the savory meat broth to plump, glistening perfection.

ingredients.name: Boneless Lamb Leg or Shoulder (cut into cubes)

steps.instruction: Sear lamb cubes in butter until browned. Add chopped onions, peppers, and tomatoes; simmer covered with 1 cup broth until meat is tender.
In a separate pan, toast orzo in remaining butter until golden and nutty.
Combine toasted orzo and stewed lamb in a round baking casserole. Pour remaining hot broth over, season with salt and pepper.
Bake covered at 375°F (190°C) until orzo absorbs all broth, then rest 10 minutes before serving.

titleEn: Braised Lamb Neck Stew with Root Vegetables
description: Hearty, nourishing Anatolian comfort soup-stew of bone-in lamb neck cuts slowly simmered with golden potatoes, carrots, pearl onions, and finished with a bright lemon-egg yolk liaison (terbiye).

ingredients.name: Bone-in Lamb Neck Slices (Kuzu Gerdan)
ingredients.substitute: Bone-in lamb shank or beef osso buco

ingredients.name: Egg Yolk & Fresh Lemon Juice (for terbiye)

steps.instruction: Place lamb neck pieces in a large stockpot, cover with cold water, bring to boil and skim off any surface foam.
Add peppercorns, shallots, carrots, and salt. Simmer covered on low heat until meat is nearly tender.
Add potatoes and continue simmering until vegetables are fork-tender and broth is rich.
Whisk egg yolk with lemon juice and 1 tbsp flour. Temper with a ladle of hot broth, stir back into the pot, and simmer 2 minutes before garnishing with parsley.
